description: This file contains unit tests for lease-based queue balancer functionality in Azure Storage within an Orleans distributed system. It includes test setup, configuration, and specific test cases for auto-scaling and node failure scenarios.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerTests
classes.description: Contains setup, configuration, and test methods for lease-based queue balancer in Azure Storage.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use Azure Blob Lease Provider, Azure Storage clustering, memory streams with lease-based queue balancer, and logging.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides default test cluster configuration to set initial silo count and add silo configurator.

methods.name: LeaseBalancedQueueBalancer_SupportAutoScaleScenario
methods.description: Test for auto-scaling behavior of the lease-based queue balancer under silo addition/removal.

methods.name: LeaseBalancedQueueBalancer_SupportUnexpectedNodeFailureScenerio
methods.description: Test for resilience of the lease-based queue balancer under unexpected node failures.

methods.name: AgentManagerOwnCorrectAmountOfAgents
methods.description: Checks if the management grain reports the correct number of agents owning queues, within expected bounds.
